about.text: originated in Marche, it is a type of formaggio di fossa, a designation for cheeses that are aged underground

sources.text: Formaggio di fossa, Marche: 20-30 days bagging then 80-100 days in the pit (Wikipedia, fossa article); Ambra version uses sheep and/or goat milk, cow in other fossa; almost no rind, mould forms on surface
